title: WebAgent-R1: Training Web Agents via End-to-End Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Zhepei Wei、Wenlin Yao、Yao Liu、Weizhi Zhang、Qin Lu、Liang Qiu、Changlong Yu、Puyang Xu、Chao Zhang、Bing Yin、Hyokun Yun、Lihong Li
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: WebAgent-R1 combines a 9,460-trajectory behavior-cloning warm-up with asynchronous current-policy WebArena rollouts, M-GRPO, and binary terminal rewards, while the online trajectories and checkpoints remain unreleased.
WebAgent-R1 用 9,460 条轨迹做行为克隆预热，配合异步的当前策略 WebArena 采样、M-GRPO 与二元终止奖励；在线轨迹与检查点均未发布。
why: It makes grouped browser episodes and interaction budgets explicit post-training objects, allowing the atlas to separate BC data, online rollout generation, environmental verification, and test-time scaling.
inclusion_reason: WebAgent-R1 provides an auditable recipe for turning current-policy browser interactions and programmatic terminal checks into multi-turn RL updates, and separately studies interaction count as a test-time budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
WebAgent-R1 addresses a training-data and optimization gap for text-based web agents. Behavior cloning can teach the browser action format, but a fixed demonstration set cannot expose the current policy to its own errors and alternative long-horizon strategies; earlier web-agent RL systems commonly rely on off-policy replay, trajectory filtering, or an additional outcome reward model. The paper instead studies end-to-end on-policy learning in a self-hosted WebArena/WebArena-Lite environment, where each record is a multi-turn episode: a user intent, text-only HTML observations, accumulated action history, one browser action per turn, environment transitions, and a terminal binary outcome.

The fixed warm-up object is the public WebArena-Lite behavior-cloning set: 1,186 valid training samples comprising 9,460 trajectories produced by program-based solvers. The online RL object is different and must not be conflated with that release: the current policy repeatedly samples browser episodes on 647 training tasks, while 165 human-verified tasks are reserved for evaluation. Those current-policy trajectories are scored by task-specific WebArena rules and grouped for M-GRPO updates. This Card belongs in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because both grouped training-time attempts and interaction-count sweeps materially affect the reported system. The paper and code expose the recipe, but no standalone online-rollout dataset or checkpoint was verified, so L4 review should retain that release boundary rather than treating benchmark success as evidence of reusable data.

WebAgent-R1 处理的是文本 Web 智能体在训练数据与优化上的缺口。行为克隆可以教授浏览器 action 格式，但固定 demonstration 集无法让当前策略面对自身错误，也难以探索不同的长程策略；较早的 Web 智能体 RL 系统通常依赖 off-policy replay、轨迹筛选或额外的 outcome reward model。论文转而研究在自托管 WebArena/WebArena-Lite 环境中的端到端 on-policy 学习，其中每条记录都是一个多轮 episode：包含用户意图、纯文本 HTML observation、累积 action history、每轮一个浏览器 action、环境转移以及终局二元结果。

固定的 warm-up 数据对象是公开的 WebArena-Lite 行为克隆集合：由 program-based solver 产生的 1,186 个有效训练样本，共含 9,460 条轨迹。在线 RL 数据对象与该发布物不同，不能混写：当前策略在 647 个训练任务上反复采样浏览器 episode，另有 165 个人工核验任务仅用于评估。这些 current-policy 轨迹由 WebArena 的 task-specific rule 打分，并按组进入 M-GRPO 更新。本 Card 归入“Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data”，因为成组的训练时尝试与交互次数 sweep 都实质影响论文系统。论文和代码公开了配方，但未核验到独立发布的在线 rollout 数据集或 checkpoint；因此 L4 审核必须保留这一发布边界，不能把 benchmark 成功率当成数据可复用性的证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The pipeline has four linked stages. First, behavior-cloning SFT on the 9,460 program-solver trajectories gives an instruction-tuned Qwen2.5-3B or Llama3.1-8B policy the basic action syntax and website skills needed to obtain nonzero rewards. Second, for each RL task, multiple browser instances start from the same page but maintain independent context, including cookies; the current policy asynchronously generates a group of distinct multi-turn histories. Third, dynamic context compression replaces earlier full HTML observations with simplified placeholders while preserving the action history, reducing memory use and shifting the loss mask as the context changes. Fourth, task-specific binary terminal rewards are normalized within each group to form relative advantages for multi-turn GRPO (M-GRPO).

The feedback contract is environmental and programmatic, not a language-model judgment. A task receives success or failure from WebArena's built-in string-match, URL-match, or program-execution checker over the final answer or web state. The reward supervises the full episode and induces token-level policy updates over action outputs, but it does not label intermediate decisions. Compared with plain BC, the policy trains on its own current failures and successes; compared with DigiRL- or WebRL-style off-policy recipes, WebAgent-R1 does not report a replay buffer, trajectory filter, or separately trained outcome reward model. The test-time analysis is a separate mechanism: it increases the allowed number of environment interactions, rather than selecting a longer single response, and measures how that episode budget changes success.

该流水线由四个相互衔接的阶段组成。第一，用 9,460 条 program-solver 轨迹做行为克隆 SFT，使 instruction-tuned Qwen2.5-3B 或 Llama3.1-8B 策略先掌握基本 action 语法与网站技能，从而有机会得到非零奖励。第二，对每个 RL 任务启动多个浏览器实例；它们从同一页面出发，但分别维护包括 cookie 在内的上下文，当前策略异步生成一组成分不同的多轮 history。第三，dynamic context compression 用简化占位内容替换较早的完整 HTML observation，同时保留 action history，并随上下文变化调整 loss mask，以降低显存开销。第四，按任务得到的二元终局奖励在组内归一化，形成 multi-turn GRPO（M-GRPO）的相对 advantage。

反馈契约来自环境与程序规则，而不是 language-model judge。WebArena 根据最终回答或 Web 状态，用内置的 string match、URL match 或 program execution checker 返回成功或失败。该奖励监督完整 episode，并通过 action 输出上的 token-level 更新影响策略，但不会标注中间决策。与纯 BC 相比，策略会在自身当前的成功与失败上训练；与 DigiRL 或 WebRL 一类 off-policy 配方相比，WebAgent-R1 没有报告 replay buffer、轨迹筛选器或单独训练的 outcome reward model。测试时分析属于另一机制：它增加允许的环境交互次数，而不是只延长单轮回答，并测量 episode budget 对成功率的影响。

title: Method
方法
html:
WebArena-Lite covers Reddit, GitLab, CMS, Map, and Shopping in a realistic self-hosted browser environment. Each task is formulated as a POMDP. At a turn, the model observes text-only HTML and its interaction history, emits one Python-style action such as Click, Type, Search, Scroll, Switch Tab, or exit, and receives the next page state. The default prompt encloses a brief rationale in think tags and the action in answer tags. An episode ends on success, the interaction cap, or exit. Earlier HTML is dynamically reduced to a “Simplified HTML” representation while the complete action history remains available.

Warm-up uses the public 9,460 trajectories from 1,186 valid program-solver samples. The main RL split contains 647 tasks; 165 human-verified tasks are held out for evaluation. Parallel browser instances generate a group of independent current-policy episodes per task from the same starting page. Rollout temperature and top-p are both 1.0, but the group size, total online trajectory count, seeds, task schedule, and default maximum interaction count are not reported in the paper text. Each episode receives a binary reward from a task-specific string, URL, or final-state program check, and M-GRPO computes group-relative advantages without a reported replay-buffer or rollout-filter stage.

Both backbones are instruction-tuned models. The paper uses full-parameter training on one node of eight 80 GB NVIDIA A100 GPUs with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 offload, gradient checkpointing, FlashAttention-2, and bf16. SFT uses learning rate 5e-5, batch size 128, cosine scheduling, and 5% warm-up; RL uses learning rate 1e-6, batch size 16, KL coefficient 0.001, clip ratio 0.2, maximum context 16,384, and maximum new tokens 1,024. QwQ-32B adds first-person explanatory CoT to existing BC fields only for WebAgent-R1-CoT. The official repository supplies nested environment setup, training, verifier, and evaluation code, but its README does not supply a pinned run manifest, online trajectories, trained checkpoints, or an immutable WebArena snapshot.

WebArena-Lite 在一个接近真实、可自托管的浏览器环境中覆盖 Reddit、GitLab、CMS、Map 和 Shopping。每个任务被表述为 POMDP。每一轮中，模型读取纯文本 HTML 与交互 history，输出一个 Python 风格 action，例如 Click、Type、Search、Scroll、Switch Tab 或 exit，并接收下一页面状态。默认 prompt 用 think 标签包裹简短推理，用 answer 标签包裹 action。episode 在成功、达到交互上限或执行 exit 时结束。较早的 HTML 会被动态压缩为“Simplified HTML”表示，但完整 action history 仍被保留。

Warm-up 使用公开的 9,460 条轨迹，它们来自 1,186 个有效 program-solver 样本。主 RL split 包含 647 个任务，另有 165 个人工核验任务留作评估。多个浏览器实例从同一起始页面出发，为每个任务生成一组彼此独立的 current-policy episode。rollout temperature 与 top-p 都为 1.0，但论文正文没有报告 group size、在线轨迹总数、随机种子、任务调度和默认最大交互次数。每个 episode 由 task-specific string、URL 或终局状态程序检查器返回二元奖励；M-GRPO 据此计算组内相对 advantage，且论文未报告 replay-buffer 或 rollout-filter 阶段。

两个 backbone 都使用 instruction-tuned 版本。论文在单节点 8 张 80 GB NVIDIA A100 上做全参数训练，并使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 offload、gradient checkpointing、FlashAttention-2 与 bf16。SFT 的 learning rate 为 5e-5、batch size 为 128，使用 cosine schedule 与 5% warm-up；RL 的 learning rate 为 1e-6、batch size 为 16、KL coefficient 为 0.001、clip ratio 为 0.2，maximum context 为 16,384，maximum new tokens 为 1,024。QwQ-32B 只在 WebAgent-R1-CoT 变体中，为现有 BC 字段补写第一人称解释性 CoT。官方仓库提供嵌套的环境搭建、训练、verifier 与评估代码，但 README 没有给出固定 revision 的运行清单、在线轨迹、训练后 checkpoint 或不可变 WebArena snapshot。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the 165-task WebArena-Lite evaluation split, Table 2 reports that Qwen2.5-3B rises from 6.1% under prompting to 20.0% after behavior cloning and 33.9% after WebAgent-R1; Llama3.1-8B rises from 8.5% to 20.6% and then 44.8%. These numbers show an improvement for the evaluated policies under the paper's environment and rubric. They do not establish that each BC trace is correct, that every online trajectory has useful intermediate actions, or that the unreleased rollouts are reusable.

The ablations make the data dependency more concrete. WebAgent-R1-Zero begins from the 6.1% prompted Qwen policy, rarely receives positive rewards, and slightly deteriorates under RL, supporting the claim that BC initialization is required in this sparse-reward setup. For WebAgent-R1-CoT, QwQ-32B augmentation improves the SFT starting point from 20.0% to 24.5%, but subsequent RL reaches 30.3%, below the standard WebAgent-R1's 33.9%; the authors hypothesize that more deterministic long-CoT patterns restrict exploration. Effects are also uneven across sites: for Qwen, Reddit falls from 42.1% after BC to 26.3% after RL and Map stays at 26.9%, even though the five-site average rises.

Table 3 associates the thinking-format prompt with more interaction rounds and higher prompting success, and Figure 5 reports higher success as the maximum interaction count increases for prompting, SFT, and RL agents. This supports interaction count as a relevant test-time budget, but the paper does not publish the exact sweep values in text or equal-budget controls against other test-time selectors. Artifact evidence is narrower than performance evidence: ACL Anthology and arXiv verify the paper, and the official Apache-2.0 repository contains environment, training, and evaluation code; no separate online-rollout dataset, trained checkpoint, tagged release, or frozen environment image was verified.

在包含 165 个任务的 WebArena-Lite 评估 split 上，表 2 报告 Qwen2.5-3B 从纯 prompting 的 6.1% 提升到行为克隆后的 20.0%，再到 WebAgent-R1 的 33.9%；Llama3.1-8B 则从 8.5% 提升到 20.6%，随后达到 44.8%。这些数字说明论文环境与 rubric 下被评估策略有所改进，但不能证明每条 BC 轨迹都正确、每条在线轨迹的中间 action 都有用，也不能证明未发布 rollout 可复用。

Ablation 更具体地显示了数据依赖。WebAgent-R1-Zero 从成功率 6.1% 的 prompted Qwen 策略开始，极少得到正奖励，RL 后还略有下降，这支持了在该稀疏奖励设置中必须先做 BC 初始化的结论。对 WebAgent-R1-CoT，QwQ-32B 数据增强把 SFT 起点从 20.0% 提高到 24.5%，但后续 RL 只达到 30.3%，低于标准 WebAgent-R1 的 33.9%；作者推测更确定的 long-CoT 模式限制了探索。不同网站上的效果也不均匀：对 Qwen，Reddit 从 BC 后的 42.1% 降到 RL 后的 26.3%，Map 保持 26.9%，尽管五个网站的平均值上升。

表 3 显示 thinking-format prompt 与更多交互轮次和更高 prompting 成功率相关，图 5 则报告对 prompting、SFT 和 RL agent，增加最大交互次数会提高成功率。这说明交互次数是相关的 test-time budget，但论文正文没有给出精确 sweep 数值，也没有与其他 test-time selector 做等预算控制。artifact 证据的边界比性能证据更窄：ACL Anthology 与 arXiv 可核验论文，官方 Apache-2.0 仓库包含环境、训练和评估代码；未核验到独立在线 rollout 数据集、训练后 checkpoint、tagged release 或冻结环境镜像。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is not single-turn mathematical RLVR but web-agent training through fixed demonstrations or off-policy experience. Behavior cloning learns only from expert actions. DigiRL and AWR reuse older trajectories, and WebRL adds GPT-4-generated data plus a separately trained outcome reward model. Concurrent multi-turn on-policy systems focus on games or coding, while search-agent RL often restricts interaction to simple API calls. WebAgent-R1 changes the web-data loop by collecting full browser episodes from the current policy and immediately optimizing them with the environment's own terminal rules.

The individual components are not wholly new: WebArena and its rule-based evaluators predate this work; behavior cloning, GRPO, parallel rollout, context compression, and interaction-budget scaling are established ideas. The differentiating contribution is their composition for text-only, long-horizon web interaction: BC supplies a reward-reachable starting policy, asynchronous browser instances produce grouped current-policy episodes, dynamic compression makes those episodes trainable, and M-GRPO uses built-in terminal checks without a replay buffer or learned outcome reward model. For this atlas, the direction signal is that the rollout group, browser state, outcome rule, and interaction limit become part of the reasoning-data contract. It is not evidence that binary-reward trajectories are intrinsically high quality, and the absence of released online episodes limits direct comparison of trajectory diversity or failure coverage.

最接近的基线不是单轮数学 RLVR，而是依赖固定 demonstration 或 off-policy experience 的 Web 智能体训练。行为克隆只学习 expert action；DigiRL 与 AWR 复用旧轨迹；WebRL 还加入 GPT-4 生成数据，并单独训练 outcome reward model。同期的 multi-turn on-policy 系统主要面向游戏或代码环境，而 search-agent RL 往往把交互限制为简单 API call。WebAgent-R1 对 Web 数据闭环的改变，是从当前策略收集完整浏览器 episode，并立即用环境自身的终局规则优化这些 episode。

各个组件本身并非全新：WebArena 及其 rule-based evaluator 早于本工作，行为克隆、GRPO、并行 rollout、上下文压缩和交互预算扩展也都是既有思路。区别性贡献在于把它们组合到纯文本、长程 Web 交互中：BC 提供能够触达正奖励的初始策略，异步浏览器实例生成成组 current-policy episode，dynamic compression 使这些 episode 可训练，M-GRPO 则直接使用内置终局检查器，而不依赖 replay buffer 或学习式 outcome reward model。对本图谱而言，方向信号是 rollout group、浏览器状态、结果规则和交互上限共同成为推理数据契约的一部分；这并不证明二元奖励轨迹天然高质量，而且在线 episode 未发布也限制了对轨迹多样性与失败覆盖的直接比较。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The feedback is sparse and terminal. String match, URL match, and program execution can verify task-specific conditions, but they do not assign credit to intermediate actions, measure reasoning faithfulness, or rule out unintended state changes that still satisfy a checker. The paper explicitly leaves fine-grained reward shaping to future work. Dynamic context compression also replaces earlier HTML with simplified placeholders; although action history is preserved, the paper does not quantify what observation evidence is lost or how compression errors affect later decisions.

Reproduction and data audit remain partial. The paper does not disclose the M-GRPO group size, total online rollout count, random seeds, exact task schedule, default interaction cap, per-run failure distribution, decontamination procedure, or a frozen environment/state manifest. The repository contains code and setup instructions, but no independently verified online trajectories, reward logs, trained checkpoints, tagged release, or immutable WebArena images. The public 9,460-trajectory BC set is stated to be Apache-2.0, while rights and licensing for newly generated online episodes are not separately documented because those episodes are not released.

The evidence is limited to text-only interaction with five WebArena-Lite sites and one held-out set of 165 tasks. Website state, authentication, cookies, task ordering, and reset behavior can change the trajectory distribution. Average gains hide regressions on individual sites, and WebAgent-R1-Zero demonstrates that sparse-reward RL may fail when the initial policy cannot emit valid actions. Long-CoT augmentation also gives a better SFT start but a smaller RL improvement, so more verbose traces are not automatically better exploration data. Finally, higher benchmark success establishes neither uniform trajectory quality nor reusable data; it only supports the evaluated policy-environment-checker configuration.

反馈是稀疏且只在终局给出的。string match、URL match 与 program execution 可以核验 task-specific 条件，但不会为中间 action 分配 credit，也不衡量推理忠实性，更无法排除满足 checker 却产生非预期状态变化的行为。论文明确把细粒度 reward shaping 留给未来工作。dynamic context compression 还会把早期 HTML 替换为简化占位内容；虽然 action history 得以保留，但论文没有量化丢失了哪些 observation 证据，也没有分析压缩错误如何影响后续决策。

复现与数据审计仍不完整。论文没有披露 M-GRPO group size、在线 rollout 总数、随机种子、精确任务调度、默认交互上限、逐次运行的失败分布、去污染流程或冻结的环境/状态 manifest。仓库包含代码与搭建说明，但未独立核验到在线轨迹、reward log、训练后 checkpoint、tagged release 或不可变 WebArena image。公开的 9,460 条 BC 轨迹被论文说明为 Apache-2.0；新生成在线 episode 的权利与许可没有单独文档，因为这些 episode 并未发布。

证据仅覆盖五个 WebArena-Lite 网站上的纯文本交互和一个含 165 个任务的留出集。网站状态、认证、cookie、任务顺序与 reset 行为都可能改变轨迹分布。平均提升会掩盖个别网站上的退化，而 WebAgent-R1-Zero 说明，当初始策略无法生成有效 action 时，稀疏奖励 RL 可能失败。long-CoT 增强虽然带来更好的 SFT 起点，RL 增益却更小，因此更冗长的轨迹不会自动成为更好的探索数据。最后，更高 benchmark 成功率既不能证明轨迹整体高质量，也不能证明数据可复用；它只支持被评估的策略—环境—checker 组合。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, WebAgent-R1 is useful as a schema and audit case for grouped environment rollouts. A reusable record should distinguish the fixed BC sample from each current-policy episode and retain task ID, starting environment state, browser-instance identity, cookies or reset context, full observations before compression, compressed context, action history, sampled response, executed action, terminal condition, checker type, binary reward, group membership, relative advantage, interaction cap, and policy/checkpoint revision. These fields let a curator separate gains due to initialization, rollout diversity, verifier behavior, optimizer settings, or a larger inference budget.

The paper directly supports four uses: SFT for the BC warm-up, RLVR-style agent training through programmatic terminal rewards, online agent-policy optimization, and test-time compute through more interaction rounds. It does not demonstrate process-reward training, reward-model learning, preference learning, or reuse of the online trajectories as a released dataset. Practitioners can use the published code and hyperparameters to study architecture and implementation choices, but exact reproduction requires pinning the WebArena state and filling the undisclosed rollout, seed, and interaction-budget details. The most valuable track-level comparison is therefore not the headline success rate; it is whether competing systems expose equivalent rollout budgets, environment snapshots, failed episodes, and verifier contracts.

对“Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data”而言，WebAgent-R1 可作为成组环境 rollout 的 schema 与审计案例。可复用记录应区分固定 BC 样本与每条 current-policy episode，并保留 task ID、起始环境状态、浏览器实例身份、cookie 或 reset 上下文、压缩前完整 observation、压缩后 context、action history、采样 response、实际执行 action、终止条件、checker 类型、二元 reward、group membership、relative advantage、交互上限以及策略/checkpoint revision。借助这些字段，整理者才能区分改进究竟来自初始化、rollout 多样性、verifier 行为、optimizer 设置还是更大的推理预算。

论文直接支持四种用途：用 BC 数据做 SFT warm-up，通过程序化终局奖励进行 RLVR 风格的 agent training，在线优化 agent policy，以及通过增加交互轮数使用 test-time compute。论文没有实证 process-reward training、reward-model learning、preference learning，也没有把在线轨迹作为已发布数据集供复用。实践者可以用公开代码与超参数研究架构和实现选择，但精确复现仍需固定 WebArena 状态，并补齐未披露的 rollout、seed 与 interaction-budget 细节。因此，本 track 中最有价值的比较不是标题中的成功率，而是不同系统是否公开等价的 rollout budget、环境 snapshot、失败 episode 与 verifier contract。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the 9,460 public program-solver BC trajectories separate from the unreleased current-policy trajectories sampled on 647 RL tasks.
  • Read the reward as a terminal task checker—string match, URL match, or program execution—not as a label of intermediate reasoning quality.
  • Treat behavior cloning as part of the RL data contract: WebAgent-R1-Zero rarely reaches positive reward and does not improve in the reported ablation.
  • Record interaction count as a test-time budget; longer multi-turn episodes, not longer single-turn responses, drive the paper's scaling analysis.
  • Before reuse, request the M-GRPO group size, rollout count, seeds, task schedule, environment snapshot, online trajectories, checkpoints, and decontamination evidence.

• 将公开的 9,460 条 program-solver BC 轨迹与在 647 个 RL 任务上采样、但未发布的 current-policy 轨迹严格分开。
  • 把 reward 理解为终局任务 checker——string match、URL match 或 program execution——而不是中间推理质量标签。
  • 将行为克隆视为 RL 数据契约的一部分：在论文 ablation 中，WebAgent-R1-Zero 很少获得正奖励，且没有改善。
  • 把交互次数记录为 test-time budget；论文的扩展分析依赖更长的多轮 episode，而不是更长的单轮 response。
  • 复用前应索取 M-GRPO group size、rollout 数量、seed、任务调度、环境 snapshot、在线轨迹、checkpoint 与去污染证据。
